query:
SELECT timestamp, source, substring(event_message,1,2400) AS message,
log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code'] AS sqlstate,
log_attributes['parsed.query'] AS query,
log_attributes['parsed.process_id'] AS pid,
log_attributes['parsed.backend_type'] AS backend_type,
log_attributes['parsed.query_id'] AS query_id,
log_attributes['parsed.timestamp'] AS database_timestamp,
log_attributes['request.method'] AS method,
splitByChar('?',log_attributes['request.path'])[1] AS path,
log_attributes['response.status_code'] AS status,
log_attributes['response.origin_time'] AS origin_ms,
log_attributes['response.headers.x_envoy_upstream_service_time'] AS upstream_ms,
log_attributes['request.headers.user_agent'] AS agent
FROM logs
WHERE (source IN ('postgres_logs','postgrest_logs','realtime_logs')
OR (source='edge_logs' AND (toFloat64OrZero(log_attributes['response.origin_time'])>=1000 OR toInt32OrZero(log_attributes['response.status_code'])>=500)))
ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT 320
